context_for_next_testing_agent: Card_type tracking feature fully implemented and tested. Key changes: 1) log_operation() in boomerang.py now extracts card_type from card_data and stores both card_type (normalized key) and card_type_label (Spanish label). 2) GET /api/operations returns card_types in filters and supports card_type query param. 3) GET /api/operations/summary returns by_card_type aggregation and card_types filter. 4) CSV/XLSX export includes 'Tipo de Tarjeta' and 'Valor del Canje' columns. 5) Frontend OperationsPage.js has card_type dropdown in both Historial filters and Dashboard filters, plus 'Por Tipo de Tarjeta' section in Dashboard. Note: Old operations may have null card_type - only new operations will have it populated.
mocked_api_note: DEMO-* cards use MOCK data for demo purposes. Real cards use live Boomerangme API.
